# FG-AUTH-0019

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`service-accounts`](../../ops/runbooks/service-accounts.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `doctor_warns_token_expiring_within_14_days` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サービスアカウントのトークンの期限が近づいています。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A service account's token expires soon. Contact the administrator.
- id: Token akun layanan akan segera kedaluwarsa. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge doctor (check service_accounts.tokens_expiring, M3 S0) found an active service account whose active tokens all expire within 14 days: nobody issued its next token yet (a token lives at most 365 days, ADR-0019). When the last one expires the integration that uses it (kanflow, a CI reporter) stops working with FG-AUTH-0001 and nothing else warns. Only doctor raises it; no request fails with it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The doctor line carries `expiring_service_accounts` (how many), `user_ids` (the first 10 service accounts), `soonest_expiry` (RFC 3339, UTC) and `within_days` (14). `gstn admin service-account tokens <id> --json` lists each account's tokens with `expires_at` and `issued_by_user_id`; `gstn admin service-account view <id>` names the owner who must arrange the rotation.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook service-accounts (rotation): an administrator issues a new token for the account in the browser session (the service account screen, or POST /api/v1/admin/service-accounts/{id}/tokens; a token can never issue one), the owner puts it into the integration's secret file, the integration is checked, then the old token is revoked (`gstn admin service-account revoke-token <id> <token id> --yes`). Re-run forge doctor: the line is ok once a token expiring later than 14 days exists.
